sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:89
items.html:
Six discernments in Ohr Yashar. The upper light is in one equanimity, and all the stated changes are relative to the recipients
First of all, one must know and remember that the upper light is in one equanimity, and all these many changes that we find in the worlds all occur on the part of the recipients, and not only that, but they come in an order of cause and effect by necessity, from the first recipient, which is the secret of the Malchut of Ein Sof, blessed be He, as written at length (in Part One, in Ohr Pnimi and Histaklut Pnimit). And after all this, no change whatsoever occurs in the upper light, and even with respect to the recipients it undergoes no change, meaning that in the end its simple light will be revealed to the recipients just as it was revealed in the first recipient, that is, in the Malchut of Ein Sof, blessed be He, before the Tzimtzum, without any change, as in the secret of the verse, "For I the Lord change not," as written there in Histaklut Pnimit. See there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:90
items.html:
Knowledge of the wisdom depends for the most part on knowing the order of unfolding of the Sefirot, the Partzufim, and the worlds in an order of cause and effect
And know that knowledge of this wisdom depends for the most part on knowledge of the order of unfolding of the Sefirot, the Partzufim, and the worlds from one another, in the aspect of "cause and derivative" by absolute necessity. And the sages of the Zohar explained this by way of secret, but no one understood their words until the Ari, of blessed memory, came and revealed the matters. And know that the whole innovation in the wisdom of the Ari, of blessed memory, over those who explained before him, is mainly in the revelation of the ways of the ten Sefirot of Ohr Chozer. For although the ten Sefirot of Ohr Chozer, in general, were revealed to all the earlier kabbalists, nevertheless the essence of their attainment and understanding was only according to the ways of the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar, until the Ari, of blessed memory, came and explained to us knowledge of the ways of Ohr Chozer in all their details. And by this he opened the sealed and locked treasuries of the books of the Holy Zohar.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:91
items.html:
All the discernments in Ohr Chozer are drawn from Ohr Yashar
However, one must know that all these many discernments, discerned in Ohr Chozer, are drawn from the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar, so that there is no small innovation in Ohr Chozer that is not drawn from Ohr Yashar. And therefore they are also called by the same names as those of Ohr Yashar, and not only are they drawn from them, but their qualities are also equal to one another, and the whole difference between them is only in the opposite relation between them, which is for the reason that this is light and that is vessel.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:92
items.html:
The Rav spoke very little of the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar
Indeed, of the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar, the Ari, of blessed memory, spoke very little, and even that with great brevity, and this is because he relied in this on the earlier kabbalists, since all their words are only of Ohr Yashar, and therefore he did not find it necessary to elaborate on them. And one must acknowledge that we greatly lack his clear knowledge of the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar, and this is a deficiency that cannot be numbered.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:93
items.html: And here there are, in the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar, six discernments that one must always remember while engaging in the wisdom, and these are they: The first discernment is that the upper light is in one equanimity, and these aspects discerned in the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar are the aspect of garments upon the upper light, except that they are not revealed at all except through their clothing in Ohr Chozer.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:94
items.html:
The number ten of the Sefirot is in Ohr Yashar, but in Ohr Chozer they are five aspects
The second discernment is that the number of the ten Sefirot is mainly only in Ohr Yashar, but in Ohr Chozer they are only five aspects, as brought in the words of the Rav (here, item 63), and elsewhere.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:95
items.html:
The ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar are considered a single illumination, and are distinguished from one another only when they clothe in Ohr Chozer
The third discernment is that the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar, in themselves, are not degrees distinguished from one another as they are when clothed in Ohr Chozer, but rather they are all considered as one single illumination; however, when they clothe within the ten Sefirot of Ohr Chozer, very great and mighty discernments are revealed between them.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:96
items.html:
There are distances in the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar from the aspect of their own essence, even though they are as a single illumination
The fourth discernment is the distances that exist in the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar from the aspect of the essence of each and every Sefirah, as written (in Part One, in Ohr Pnimi, page 5, under the heading "and the reason"), see there well the entire continuation, and in Histaklut Pnimit there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:97
items.html:
Whatever is in the derivative receives from its cause. And the essence of the illumination remains in its cause, and only a branch of it is imparted to the derivative
The fifth discernment is the great distance between cause and derivative, and whatever is in the derivative, it receives this from its cause, and it cannot receive anything from any degree that is above its cause without the mediation of its cause. And whatever the cause imparts to the derivative, it is found that the essence of the illumination remains in the cause, and only a small branch of it is imparted and comes to the derivative, even though the essence of the illumination came only for the sake of the derivative (see above, item 24).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:98
items.html:
Whatever is closer to aspect four is discerned as thicker
The sixth discernment is the discernment of closeness to aspect four. For whatever is closer to aspect four is discerned as thicker and lower, as above in item 23. And this discernment begins in the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar only from the Tzimtzum downward, when aspect four became an empty void and was corrected with a Masach. And therefore this discernment does not apply in Igulim, since there is no Masach there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, Histaklut Penimit 6:99
items.html: Now, all these stated discernments, except for the last one, apply to the ten Sefirot of Ohr Yashar even before the Tzimtzum, and although we have no attainment at all of what preceded the Tzimtzum, nevertheless, from the lower one may learn of the upper one, as is known. And remember these discernments well, and let them not slip from your eyes when you engage in the study of the wisdom.
